events.name: Downtown Farmers Market
events.note: Every Saturday, 50+ regional vendors and live music. No market Nov 14.
events.description: The largest farmers market in Washington County, at Vernon Worthen Park every Saturday. Vendors from Washington and Iron counties bring produce, pasture-raised meats, cheeses and artisan goods, and live music starts about 30 minutes after opening.
know: Free street parking and nearby public lots.

events.name: MOD the Modern Market
events.note: Local artisans, boutiques and food trucks. Free admission.
events.description: A semi-annual pop-up market of local artisans, boutiques and food trucks in Vernon Worthen Park, now in its 9th edition.

events.name: Concerts at the Electric: The Bombshell Flowers
events.note: Free city concert series; first-come seating, donations welcome.
events.description: A free City of St. George concert at the historic Electric Theater featuring The Bombshell Flowers, a Utah alternative rock trio.

events.name: Concerts at the Electric: Color Country Choir
events.description: A free City of St. George concert at the Electric Theater with the Color Country Choir.

events.name: Kickoff to Christmas
events.note: Santa photos, choirs, cookies and cocoa. Children's museum open late.
events.description: St. George's yearly holiday kickoff on the Monday after Thanksgiving. Santa visits for pictures, school choirs and local talent perform, hot chocolate and cookies are served while supplies last, and the Children's Museum stays open late with crafts.
know: The event is free, but standard carousel fees apply.

events.name: Dickens' Christmas Festival
events.place: Dixie Convention Center, 1835 Convention Center Dr
events.note: Victorian holiday craft market. Adults $12, seniors/kids 5–12 $10, 4 & under free.
events.description: A Victorian 'Olde London' holiday market at the Dixie Convention Center with costumed merchants, handpicked vendors and characters like Father Christmas. It's a craft show and family holiday outing in one.
know: Adults $12; seniors 65+ and kids 5–12 $10; 4 and under free.
Tickets online or onsite; 4-day passes $20 onsite.

events.name: North Pole Express
events.note: Santa, cookies, crafts and a train ride. Tickets on sale Nov 16; buy ahead.
events.description: A City of St. George holiday event at Thunder Junction All Abilities Park. Meet Santa, decorate cookies, enjoy cocoa and crafts, and ride the North Pole Express train under the park lights.
know: Tickets go on sale Nov 16 at 10am and must be bought ahead; no refunds.
$12 per person; ages 2 and under free.

events.name: Light the Night
events.note: Make a luminary, cocoa, crafts, live music and the new winter exhibits.
events.description: The St. George Art Museum opens its winter exhibitions with hot chocolate, donuts, crafts and live music. Make a luminary for the courtyard and meet the incoming artists.

events.name: Winged Wonders Bird Watch
events.place: Sand Hollow State Park main boat ramp, Hurricane
events.description: Over 250 bird species visit the Sand Hollow reservoir each year. Bring a chair or blanket and join a park ranger near the jetty to spot them; binoculars are provided.

events.name: Love Local Holiday Market
events.place: Dixie Convention Center parking lot, 1835 S Convention Center Dr
events.note: Free; Santa photos, food trucks, free bounce houses.
events.description: A free Christmas-themed market with local vendors, food trucks, photo ops, giveaways and pictures with Santa. Bounce houses are free for kids.

events.name: Campfire Chat with s'mores
events.note: S'mores provided; bring chairs and cocoa.
events.description: Join a park ranger for an evening around the fire at Sand Hollow. Bring chairs; s'mores are provided by Lin's in Hurricane.

events.name: Fee-Free Day at Zion (Veterans Day)
events.note: Entrance fee waived for U.S. residents.
events.description: Veterans Day is a National Park Service fee-free day, so Zion's entrance fee is waived for U.S. citizens and residents. Other fees, like camping, still apply.

events.name: Art of Adventure Nature Journaling
events.description: A mid-morning nature journaling adventure with a park ranger, learning ways to be creative outdoors. Nature journals and drawing materials are provided.

events.name: Movie Meetup at Sand Hollow
events.place: Sand Hollow State Park, 3351 Sand Hollow Rd, Hurricane
events.note: Outdoor movie; food vendors. Weather dependent.
events.description: Sand Hollow State Park hosts an outdoor movie night; bring blankets and chairs. Food vendors will be on site, so come early for snacks.

events.name: Every Kid Outdoors: Share Nature with a Friend
events.description: Join a park ranger for fun in the sand as part of the Share Nature With A Friend 'Every Kid Outdoors' challenge, and walk away with an EKO sticker.

events.name: Full Moon Stroll
events.description: Join a park ranger for a chat about the full moon while strolling along Sand Hollow's beach.

events.name: Holiday Lights at Red Hills Desert Garden
events.description: A winter wonderland of thousands of lights and displays at Red Hills Desert Garden, on nightly until 10 p.m. All events are free and open to the public.

events.name: Tabernacle: St. George Interfaith Choir
events.description: The St. George Interfaith Choir, with members from more than 10 faith communities, performs with the new young-adult choir St. George Voices. All Tabernacle events are free.

events.name: Tabernacle: Christian Erickson Jazz & Holiday
events.description: Local jazz and blues singer Christian Erickson swings into the holidays with standards and a few holiday tunes. Free to the public.

events.name: Tabernacle: Bar G Wranglers
events.description: The Bar G Wranglers, known for true western harmony and family-friendly shows, perform a free evening at the Tabernacle.

events.name: Historic District Walking Tour
events.description: Historic District Walking Tour at Historic Downtown St. George. Free.

events.name: Tuacahn Saturday Market
events.place: Tuacahn Center for the Arts, Ivins
events.description: Tuacahn Saturday Market at Tuacahn Center for the Arts, Ivins. Every Saturday, year-round (10am–2pm Oct–Apr). Free.

events.name: SunRiver Veterans Honor Park Veterans Day Service
events.place: SunRiver Veterans Honor Park, St. George
events.description: SunRiver Veterans Honor Park Veterans Day Service at SunRiver Veterans Honor Park, St. George. Free.

events.name: Washington City Veterans Day Parade & Program
events.description: Washington City Veterans Day Parade & Program at Veterans Park, Washington. Free.

events.name: Veterans Day at Utah Tech & the Tabernacle
events.place: Utah Tech University (1pm) and St. George Tabernacle (7pm)
events.description: Veterans Day at Utah Tech & the Tabernacle at Utah Tech University (1pm) and St. George Tabernacle (7pm). Free.

events.name: Fractured Lands Opening Reception
events.place: Sears Art Museum, Utah Tech University
events.description: Fractured Lands Opening Reception at Sears Art Museum, Utah Tech University. Free.

events.name: U.S. Navy Band Commodores
events.description: U.S. Navy Band Commodores at Tuacahn Amphitheatre, Ivins. Free with reservation.

events.name: Ivins Community Holiday Youth Market
events.description: Ivins Community Holiday Youth Market at Mojave Estates Park, Ivins. Free.

events.name: Artisan Holiday Market
events.description: Artisan Holiday Market at Heritage Hall, Washington. Free.

events.name: Christmas in Dixie Tree Lighting
events.description: Christmas in Dixie Tree Lighting at Veterans Park, Washington. Free.

events.name: Samichlaus Abend
events.place: Across from Santa Clara Town Hall
events.description: Samichlaus Abend at Across from Santa Clara Town Hall. Free.

events.name: Pearl Harbor & USS Utah Remembrance
events.description: Pearl Harbor & USS Utah Remembrance at Heritage Hall, Washington. Free.

events.name: Washington City New Year's Eve Fireworks
events.description: Washington City New Year's Eve Fireworks at Washington City ball complex. Free.

events.name: McQuarrie Museum Talk: Exploring Snow Canyon
events.description: McQuarrie Museum Talk: Exploring Snow Canyon at McQuarrie Memorial Museum, St. George. Free.

events.name: St. George Heritage Day (165th Birthday)
events.description: St. George Heritage Day (165th Birthday) at St. George Social Hall. Free.

events.place: Snow Canyon State Park, 1002 Snow Canyon Dr, Ivins
events.name: Under the Milky Way at Snow Canyon
events.note: Telescopes and constellation tour at Scenic Overlook. Bring a chair, blanket and red flashlight.
events.description: A ranger-led evening under the stars at Snow Canyon Scenic Overlook with telescopes, a constellation tour and hands-on activities. Park entry applies.

events.place: Upper Galoot Picnic Area, Snow Canyon State Park
events.name: Lunch and Learn at Snow Canyon
events.note: Bring your lunch; topic changes each month.
events.description: Pack a lunch and join a Snow Canyon naturalist at Upper Galoot Picnic Area to learn what makes the park unique. Topics change monthly.

events.place: Snow Canyon State Park, 1002 Snow Canyon Dr, Ivins
events.name: Nature's Bounty Guided Hike
events.note: Registration required via Snow Canyon Visitor Center (435) 628-2255.
events.description: A moderate ranger-led hike exploring human and plant relationships on Snow Canyon trails. Registration is required through the visitor center.

events.place: Sand Dunes Picnic Area, Snow Canyon State Park
events.name: Stretch and Sketch at Snow Canyon
events.note: Bring a notebook and sketching utensil.
events.description: Guided stretches and nature journaling at Sand Dunes Picnic Area in Snow Canyon. Bring a half-filled notebook and something to write or sketch with.

events.place: Upper Galoot Picnic Area, Snow Canyon State Park
events.name: Lunch and Learn at Snow Canyon
events.note: Bring your lunch; topic changes each month.
events.description: Pack a lunch and join a Snow Canyon naturalist at Upper Galoot Picnic Area to learn what makes the park unique. Topics change monthly.

events.name: Jubilee of Trees
events.place: Dixie Convention Center, 1835 Convention Center Dr
events.note: Designer trees and wreaths benefiting St. George Regional Hospital. Gala Dinner & Auction Fri Nov 20.
events.description: Intermountain Health Foundation's Jubilee of Trees fills the Dixie Convention Center with professionally decorated trees and wreaths sold and auctioned to fund care at St. George Regional Hospital. Public hours Wed/Thu/Sat 11am–9pm; Friday closes at 2pm for the Gala.

events.name: Utah Tech Trailblazer Tree Lighting
events.place: Holland Building / Trailblazer Boulevard, Utah Tech University
events.note: Free. 40-foot tree lights at 6pm. Carriage rides, Santa photos, ornament giveaway for first 500.
events.description: Utah Tech University's annual free Trailblazer Nation Tree Lighting Celebration on campus. Live music, seasonal treats, booths, carriage and tractor rides, Santa photos and the lighting of the 40-foot tree at 6pm.

events.name: Holiday Village in Downtown St. George
events.place: Downtown St. George, near Town Square
events.note: Downtown Farmers Market and Roam Wild Market holiday market. Shopper hours not posted on the organizer page yet.
events.description: Downtown St. George becomes a Holiday Village of artisan gifts, handcrafted goods and festive food under the town square holiday lights.
